using namespace std;

vector<int> multiply(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(need - 1)));

    vector<double> ar(n, 0.0), ai(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {

        ai[i] = x >> 15;
    }

    vector<double> br(n, 0.0), bi(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        int x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        br[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
        bi[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(br, bi, false);

    vector<double> cr1(n, 0.0), ci1(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> cr2(n, 0.0), ci2(n, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        double a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5;
        double b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5;

        cr1[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        ci1[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        cr2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        ci2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(cr1, ci1, true);
    fft(cr2, ci2, true);

    vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = llround(cr1[i]);
        long long bb = llround(cr2[i]);
        long long cc = llround(ci1[i]);
        res[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);

    return res;
}

void fft(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inv) {
    int n = re.size();
    int shift = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = __builtin_reverse(i) >> shift;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(re[i], re[j]);
            swap(im[i], im[j]);
        }
    }

    vector<double> cs(n), sn(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        double ang = 2 * M_PI * i / n * (inv ? -1 : 1);
        cs[i] = cos(ang);
        sn[i] = sin(ang);
    }

    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0, w = n / len; j < half; j++, w *= 2) {
                double wr = cs[w * j];
                double wi = sn[w * j];
                double x = re[i + j + half] * wr - im[i + j + half] * wi;
                double y = re[i + j + half] * wi + im[i + j + half] * wr;
                re[i + j + half] = re[i + j] - x;
                im[i + j + half] = im[i + j] - y;
                re[i + j] += x;
                im[i + j] += y;
            }
        }
    }

    if (inv) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            re[i] /= n;
            im[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}
